explanation: The patch rejects index lists whose starting address lies in the output, but misses an output that starts inside the index list. The witness uses that offset overlap so output bytes replace later validated indices before gemmology reads them.
local_verification: ASan shell rebuilt successfully. The focused I8SelectColumnsOfB jit-test passed. The witness produced an AddressSanitizer fatal read on the edited build, while a temporary build using the reference two-sided overlap guard exited successfully.
